name: Pesaro (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the full achievement of the municipal arms of Pesaro (a castle on blue, with helm, crest, mantling and motto scroll).
history: Municipal flag of Pesaro, a comune in Marche; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pesaro arms — castle on blue, with helm, crest, mantling and motto scroll
